short: Storybook's stories, docs pages and frame
is: The component gallery's content in Storybook: Svelte CSF stories files (`<group>/<Name>.stories.svelte`), MDX docs pages (`<group>/<Name>.mdx`), made-up fixtures (`fixtures/*.ts`), and `frame/`, the decorator every story renders in, which carries the toolbar's Skin and Motion choices onto the page.
conventions: A stories file imports only `@storybook/addon-svelte-csf`, `storybook/test` and `@zurfur/ui` by its public entry, plus relative files under `src/stories/` and `src/gallery/`; a path into `src/lib/`, `bits-ui` or any other package is refused (`src/checks/story-imports.spec.ts`). Stories carry no `<style>`, `style=` or `style:` and no `a11y` setting: looks come from the components and the frame.

The folder is ESLint's `stories` file set, in the gallery host tier: the host's bans hold (no `fetch`, no storage, no remote or `javascript:` string, no raw HTML, no script markup, no inline handler, no dynamic import).

A docs page (`.mdx`, allowed only under `src/stories/`) holds only `import { Meta, Story } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks';`, `import * as X from './<Name>.stories.svelte';` from its own folder, one `<Meta of={X} />`, Markdown headings, plain prose, blank lines and `<Story of={X.<Story>} />` lines; any other import or JSX, `{` outside `of={…}`, `export`, an image, a link, raw HTML or a URL is refused (`src/checks/docs-pages.spec.ts`).

Every component `src/lib/index.ts` exports has a stories file whose `defineMeta.component` is that component imported from `@zurfur/ui`, and a contract spec; a pending list names the controls still waiting for stories and may only shrink (`src/checks/story-coverage.spec.ts`). Fixtures and stories files carry only the reserved sample DID and handles ending in `.test` or `.example`, a bare domain in a handle-named field, variable or attribute is refused too, and a stories file that does not parse is refused (`src/checks/story-fixtures.spec.ts`, which reads `fixtures/*.ts` and every `*.stories.svelte`).
Titles and story names are in Title Case ("Tokens and Paper/Colour", "Controls/Button"); the sidebar order is `.storybook/preview.ts`'s.
Storybook and the Vitest story projects run only through the package's scripts, under `env -i` and the network guard (see `frontend/ui`).
entry_points: frame/StoryFrame.svelte (the decorator every story renders in)

fs.name: frame/
fs.role: StoryFrame.svelte (sets data-skin and data-motion on <html> and on a wrapping div, the portal target, from the toolbar's globals, and paints a docs page's background and text from the skin's tokens), FrameSkin.svelte (resolves Follow the OS to the skin showing), globals.ts (parseSkinChoice and parseMotion: address text to closed unions, unknown text meaning Follow the OS and Lively) and their specs

fs.name: tokens/
fs.role: the six token pages as docs pages: <Name>Page.svelte (the page body, also rendered by the old gallery's route wrapper), <Name>.stories.svelte (one Page story, showing only the skin the toolbar picks) and <Name>.mdx (its docs page), for Colour, Type, Space and Shape, Shadows, Motion and Sound, Paper
